title: WHEN YOU CAN’T STAND… GOD STILL CAN.
paragraphs: WHEN YOU CAN’T STAND… GOD STILL CAN.

Sometimes the hardest race in life isn’t against others.
It’s against the voice inside you saying “You failed.”

But God never asked you to be perfect.
He asked you to trust Him.
Your weakest moment may become the place where God shows His greatest strength.

📖 “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.”
— 2 Corinthians 12:9
